items.title: 67849_Leroy Elliot Stewart oral history interview
items.q: I learned how to do it from the experience I had, especially playing with Ray Perry

ctx.x: Ray Perry, yeah. Perry it was. And, of course, who else did they have. The guitar player, I can't remember his name. But that's the way I really had quite an experience in playing with this group.
Oh, went to well, you worked in that band.
